# Worker Service Recovery Checkpoint Commit Order

On 2026-02-14, a recovery test confirmed that the queue checkpoint must be committed only after both the artifact manifest rename and artifact blob rename succeed. Any rename failure leaves the checkpoint at its prior offset to allow job retry in the Worker Service recovery path.

# analytics.page_events Query Constraints

Every query on analytics.page_events must include an event_date filter because the warehouse refuses full table scans. For reports needing more than 90 days of history, read from the page_events_daily rollup instead of querying the base table directly.

# Quarantine Test Policy

A test that fails and then passes on retry is tagged @quarantine and moves from the blocking ci-integration job to the non-blocking nightly-quarantine job. Quarantined tests never gate a merge, and the owning team fixes or deletes them within five working days.

# DNS TTL Adjustment Procedure

Lower DNS record TTL to 60 seconds one day before pointing to a new target, then restore to 3600 seconds after the new target serves traffic for 24 hours. All DNS record changes must occur only through `dns/zones.tf` and never in the provider console.
